# AI Agent Instructions

**All project documentation, workflow guidelines, and quality standards have been consolidated into [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md).**

## Quick Reference

For comprehensive documentation, see **[CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md)**, which includes:

- **Pre-Commit Checklist** - Complete 8-step workflow
- **Code Conventions** - TypeScript, React, testing standards
- **Architecture Notes** - PWA, AboutSection, testing infrastructure
- **Code Quality Standards** - Testing, style, type safety, error handling
- **AI-Specific Guidelines** - When to auto-fix, update tests, report issues
- **Workflow Example** - Complete end-to-end workflow
- **Troubleshooting** - Solutions to common issues
- **CI/CD Expectations** - Pipeline behavior and requirements
- **Golden Rules** - Core principles and priority order

## Why This Change?

Previously, documentation was split between:
- `.github/AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md` - Workflow and quality guidelines
- `CLAUDE.md` - Project reference

This caused:
- ❌ Duplication and maintenance burden
- ❌ Confusion about which file to update
- ❌ Risk of documentation getting out of sync

Now:
- ✅ Single source of truth in CLAUDE.md
- ✅ All project knowledge in one place
- ✅ Easier to discover and maintain
